figures.caption: Parsing publishes a descriptor without decoding the raster.
figures.alt: Five details at parse_return show success and pixel count four in registers, a sixteen-byte descriptor with width two, height two and raster offset eleven, the original twenty-three source bytes and unpublished caller controls.

figures.caption: The decoder has stored four pixels before its final return is implemented.
figures.alt: Five details after_d_store show the source cursor at the twenty-three-byte end, zero remaining pixels, the framebuffer cursor sixteen bytes past its base, four little-endian color words and private metadata. The unfinished return still produces development status four.

figures.alt: Five details after_e_maxval show the serialization cursor eleven bytes into destination, the exact canonical P6 header ending in one LF, untouched raster storage, original four framebuffer words and unpublished result controls.

figures.alt: Five details at save_done show native file descriptor three, accepted-byte count twenty-three, the exact source image, private validated metadata and unpublished caller controls. This ordinary host-file capture does not impose the separate core test's three-byte write limit.
